objective: Add an out-of-band digest pinned qualification-policy parser that rejects candidate-selected acceptance scope, stale/rolled-back policy epochs and mismatched dossier identities. Never treat a matching digest as authenticated custody or release authority.
nonGoals: No issuer signing, GitHub release or target deployment
No productionQualified=true based on candidate-authored policy, digest or claimed evidence
No changing prior source gates or CI settings
decisions: Use strict canonical UTF-8 JSON and SHA-256 pin supplied through separately owned operator channel; caller controls minimum epoch and date.
A policy digest only establishes byte agreement, not who authorized policy or whether offline root freshness remains valid.

obligations.description: Reject invalid/duplicate fields, noncanonical policy, symlinks, policy digest substitution, expired epoch or downgrade
Bind dossier candidate commit/tree/artifact and reference profile identity to expected operator policy
Report match as developer observation with all release/qualification authority flags false

structure: src/sf/qualification_policy.py strict operator-pinned policy and dossier scope match
impact: New read-only assessment API with no ambient network/credentials/target writes

budget.execution: One PR CI run after stable source, no redundant retry

externalEffects: Only isolated GitHub branch/PR and source files
No merge before PR #44; no release or adopter mutation
